models.name: scenario-profile-apply-publication
models.title: Explicit source application and separate publication
models.trigger: Owner has changed shared information and chooses whether to preview/apply it for one resume.
models.preconditions: Authorized source/resume contexts and the saved source change are identified; independent text and prior publication are known.
models.postcondition: Only explicitly selected draft changes apply; separate confirmation changes intended publication. Other resumes, independent text and actual submitted material remain preserved.
models.exceptions: No apply or no publish leaves the corresponding state unchanged. Stale/conflicting/failed application is not success; unauthorized paths are denied before content/change access.
models.gate: Accepted Q-D07 core applies now. Source removal and exact concurrency reconciliation remain distinct proposals.

models.name: scenario-pdf-settings
models.title: PDF settings without implicit link changes
models.trigger: Owner explicitly requests a download-configuration change.
models.preconditions: Intended resume, current mode and language/artifact availability are identified.
models.postcondition: Actual permitted mode/language choices are saved; link enabled/disabled state is not changed by this action.
models.exceptions: Unauthorized request changes no settings. Invalid/unavailable/failed processing is explicit; neither mode does not disable the resume page/link.
models.gate: Q-D10 mode timing and artifact details remain proposed; active-session/in-flight effects are not inferred.

models.name: scenario-disable-sharing-link
models.title: Independent link disable and fresh access
models.trigger: Owner separately requests disablement of a specific link.
models.preconditions: Link identity and current owner-control authority exist; no preceding PDF settings change is required.
models.postcondition: After confirmed effective disablement, a fresh request cannot gain protected access through that link; download configuration is unchanged.
models.exceptions: Denied/failed/unconfirmed disablement is not reported complete. Already delivered bytes cannot be recalled; existing sessions/caches/in-flight effects remain policy-specific.
models.gate: Reuse the existing separate operation under UC-D02; do not allocate a new external use-case ID.

models.name: scenario-protected-retrieval
models.title: Selected protected retrieval and unavailable variants
models.trigger: Employer viewer opens an intended link and requests a page, evidence or PDF.
models.preconditions: Controlled link/password context and selected published content are identifiable; viewer account is not required.
models.postcondition: Only currently permitted selected/available content is exposed; no private workspace or unrelated resource authority is granted.
models.exceptions: Wrong password, disabled link, altered resource and unselected content are denied. Missing language/artifact and retrieval failure are explicit; no unrelated fallback.
models.gate: Password/session, exact revocation timing and language-fallback proposals retain Q-D05/Q-D09/Q-D11 status.

models.name: scenario-application-preparation
models.title: Manual preparation and separate progress change
models.trigger: Applicant prepares an application or explicitly updates progress.
models.preconditions: Permitted company/opportunity, application and selected-resume contexts are identified.
models.postcondition: Actual preparation is retained; separately permitted progress records reflect the requested transition, not inferred external receipt.
models.exceptions: Inaccessible resume/application is denied. Incomplete drafts follow proposed rules; save failure/conflict is explicit; correction preserves required time/history context.
models.gate: Q-D12 fields/states, Q-D13 capture coupling and Q-D14 correction details remain proposed.

models.name: scenario-actual-submission-capture
models.title: Preserve actual material, not current live substitutes
models.trigger: Applicant identifies actual submitted resume/letter material for the intended application.
models.preconditions: Actor/application authority and actual claimed material/event context are available; current live content is not presumed identical.
models.postcondition: Confirmed captured material remains identifiable independently of later edits/publication; incomplete capture cannot claim complete preservation.
models.exceptions: Wrong-owner retrieval/change is denied. Actual upload may differ from current PDF. Missing/failed capture is incomplete/failed; corrections/resubmissions preserve distinguishable prior/new context.
models.gate: Q-D13 completeness/provenance and Q-D14 correction/retention remain proposed; accepted historical independence is already settled.

models.name: scenario-gmail-read-send-outcomes
models.title: Read or deliberately send with truthful provider outcomes
models.trigger: User separately requests correspondence reading or a reviewed send/reply.
models.preconditions: Intended account, product/resource authority and provider capability must be valid for the chosen operation; controlled access is a future gate.
models.postcondition: Read exposes permitted content; send/reply reports only provider-supported acceptance, failure or uncertainty, never invented delivery/read.
models.exceptions: Missing/revoked/wrong-account authority prevents provider action. Unknown send is reconciled before a proposed explicit retry; no blind duplicate send.
models.gate: Q-D15 actual OAuth/access remains unestablished. Q-D16 compose/reply/draft/repetition policies are proposals, not verified behavior.

models.name: scenario-calendar-local-sync
models.title: Local calendar action versus selected provider synchronization
models.trigger: User requests a local activity action or a separate agreed synchronization action.
models.preconditions: Actor/activity context, time meaning and optional selected provider mapping are identified; synchronization requires applicable connection authority.
models.postcondition: Only the permitted local/provider action is reported; time, mapping, conflict/freshness and local notes/associations retain correct context.
models.exceptions: Wrong grant denies action. Concurrent local/provider changes are not silently overwritten. Missing/revoked access and uncertain provider update stay distinguishable; reconnect does not replay stale work.
models.gate: Q-D17 direction/time/conflict/deletion/reconnect policies are proposed. Reminders require separately available delivery capability.

models.name: scenario-work-refine-plan-end
models.title: Independent refinement, Sprint planning and Sprint-end actions
models.trigger: Authorized participant requests refinement, Sprint-plan change or a separate Sprint-end action.
models.preconditions: Intended project/item/Sprint and current authority/state are identified; source-required relationship/transition policies govern the action.
models.postcondition: Task refinement, coherent goal/items/plan or actual Sprint outcome is retained for the requested operation, without equating task progress with item acceptance.
models.exceptions: Denied or stale/conflicting moves do not succeed. Incomplete work stays identifiable and is not silently accepted, erased or automatically carried over.
models.gate: Q-D18/Q-D19 counts/states/acceptance/carry-over/concurrency are proposed; accepted one-composite-Sprint-Backlog meaning is preserved.

models.name: scenario-collaboration-and-changed-grant
models.title: Invitation acceptance and resource-scoped changed access
models.trigger: Invited person accepts an eligible invitation and requests a granted action; owner may later change membership.
models.preconditions: Specific invitation/resource/action scope is identified; neither invitation nor sign-in grants unrelated private content.
models.postcondition: Only confirmed current resource grants permit the intended operation; unrelated mail/resume/repository/secret access remains denied.
models.exceptions: Expired/ineligible invitation follows adopted policy; unconfirmed persistence is not effective membership. Changed-grant and in-flight behavior retain separate policy review.
models.gate: Q-D04/Q-D05 exact grants, invitation lifecycle and revocation timing remain proposed; no role hierarchy or arbitrary expiry is invented.

models.name: scenario-git-transfer
models.title: Real Git read transfer versus authorized ref update
models.trigger: Authorized client requests clone/read transfer or supplies an intended push/ref change.
models.preconditions: A future supported client/transport and real repository context must exist; actor/repository/ref authority and expected current context are explicit.
models.postcondition: Only actual authorized repository transfer/ref result is reported; push does not imply merge approval, workflow execution or deployment.
models.exceptions: Wrong grant/protected ref is rejected. Changed ref or interrupted transfer produces conflict/incomplete/unknown as appropriate, not invented success or unrelated ref changes.
models.gate: Q-D21 transports/credentials/protection/repetition and actual interoperability remain proposals/design evidence gates.

models.name: scenario-pull-request-review-merge
models.title: Current source/target and revision-related review
models.trigger: Participant separately opens a request, records review/comment or requests merge.
models.preconditions: Applicable repository/source/target and operation authority are explicit; no second delivery person or approval count is assumed.
models.postcondition: Only the requested permitted record/review/current eligible integration is reported; evaluated source/target and actual result remain identifiable.
models.exceptions: Changed source/target is re-evaluated; stale review/checks and merge conflicts cannot masquerade as current successful integration. Unauthorized merge remains denied.
models.gate: Q-D22 review validity, merge strategy, solo review exception and counts remain proposed. Merge/release never inherits deployment authority.

models.name: scenario-workflow-admission-attempt
models.title: Gated run admission and attributable actual attempts
models.trigger: Eligible actor/trigger requests supported workflow work for identified code/definition.
models.preconditions: Future enabling evidence, permitted trigger, supported definition, scoped authority, isolation/resources/secrets and actual evaluated revision context must satisfy their gates before execution.
models.postcondition: Admitted future run/attempt/output remains attributable to exact evaluated context; blocked/failed/unknown work is not reported successful.
models.exceptions: Unsupported contract or missing authority/enabling evidence means no execution. Runner loss/cancel/retry retains actual or unknown state; cancellation request is not proof of termination.
models.gate: Q-D23 isolation/resource/contract evidence is missing today. Model future eligibility without enabling work on the current host.

models.name: scenario-separate-deployment
models.title: Target-authorized deployment is a separate goal
models.trigger: Actor separately requests deployment of an identified artifact/revision to an intended target.
models.preconditions: Target authority/approval, compatible data/recovery conditions and exact artifact/revision are explicit; successful build alone is insufficient.
models.postcondition: Only independently permitted intended target effects are attempted; actual confirmed, failed or unknown target outcome is retained.
models.exceptions: Missing target approval, stale artifact/revision or unsuitable conditions deny deployment. An unknown outcome is reconciled before further consequential action.
models.gate: Q-D23 target/approval/execution feasibility remains gated; no target or production change is created by this analysis.

models.name: scenario-policy-admission-evidence
models.title: Effective policy, file admission and restricted evidence
models.trigger: Actor requests one permitted policy, file-admission or evidence operation. Admission refines supporting file paths in the existing scenarios rather than allocating a new external use case.
models.preconditions: Current role/resource/action authority, effective policy and actual content/usage/reference context are identified; administrative authority differs from upload authority.
models.postcondition: Actual effective policy, usable admitted resource or permitted bounded evidence is reported for the requested operation only.
models.exceptions: Denied operations expose no restricted data. Failed persistence/processing/cleanup does not claim effective settings, usable content or freed capacity; lower limit does not silently delete history.
models.gate: Q-D24 numerical values/pools/concurrency and Q-D27 applicability remain proposals; actual capacity is not inferred from idle free disk.

models.name: scenario-isolated-recovery-assessment
models.title: Conditional isolated restoration and safe reconciliation
models.trigger: Operator identifies a loss/recovery scenario and requests an explicitly authorized isolated drill.
models.preconditions: Identified protected recovery source, required artifacts/configuration, defined coverage/targets, suitable isolation and operator authority must actually exist for a later drill.
models.postcondition: Actual findings identify covered/restored information, integrity, safe current access, external-state disposition and measured target comparison; no success is assumed before evidence.
models.exceptions: No authority/source/safe target blocks the drill. Missing/corrupt/inconsistent material or missed targets remain failed/incomplete. Revisit only under isolated authorized recovery policy.
models.gate: Backups are not configured. Q-D26 source/coverage/targets/restore proof and Q-D27 operating evidence remain open; this is not execution authorization.

findings: SB-F01: preparation/progress needs its distinct function/data flow; do not equate DA-F06 capture
SB-F02: remaining detailed policies retain status; accepted core is not reopened
limits: No new external use-case/story/scenario identifiers allocated
No universal rollback, replay, locking or revocation timing selected

actual_artifact_checks.visual_review: All 16 renders inspected; excessive wrapping corrected; longest revised render side below 1600 pixels
actual_artifact_checks.limit: Document/model checks, not product execution or full criterion coverage
